name: Toledo Mafia Counts
description: Toledo Mafia Counts (TMC) is a set of the Latin Counts street gang, a People Nation-affiliated organization. The set originated on the 5600 block of Toledo Street in southwest Detroit, Michigan. TMC maintained a rivalry with a Latin Kings set active in Clark Park and Mexicantown, which it eventually overpowered. Its former president, Christopher 'C-5' Rishell, was sentenced to 20 years in federal prison in 2019 following a 2017 drive-by shooting. The set is considered defunct or severely diminished following federal prosecutions.
